_comment: Pinned third-party runtime for the G-TRADE Windows edition. SHA-256 values recorded 2026-11-12 from the official URLs; vendor signatures checked at that time (see PHASE_3_COMPLETION_REPORT.md section 4). A mismatch stops the build.

nginx.vendor_signature: PGP nginx-1.30.6.zip.asc, key D6786CE303D9A9022998DC6CC8464D549AF75C0A (Sergey Kandaurov); binary is not Authenticode-signed upstream

winsw.vendor_signature: none upstream; must be signed by the publisher's certificate in the release pipeline

postgresql.source: EDB Windows x64 binaries (local install at C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17 or the EDB binaries zip)

xlsx.vendor_signature: matches package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js in the npm registry tarball (npm sha512 integrity verified); same version the cloud edition loads from the CDN
